### Added

- (agent-platform) [Create an agent on a Harness picked in the wizard](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2637) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — In the new-agent wizard, the details step offers a `Runtime` choice among the namespace's Harnesses, e.g. Claude Code. The platform default stays preselected, and the review names the choice.
- (agent-platform, muster) [Track cluster and node pool creation; every write through useTrackedMutation](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2718) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: portals with TelemetryDeck report creating a cluster and creating a node pool as two new events. Nothing visible changes.
- (catalog) [Build status processor and declared build toolchain in the catalog](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2271) by [@weatherhog](https://github.com/weatherhog) — The catalog table gets a sortable `Build toolchain` column and an `Architect orb` filter, and a component's readiness card says whether its default branch builds (with `catalog.processors.buildStatus.enabled`).
- (scaffolder-backend-module-gs, gs-node) [Gs:oci:tagExists scaffolder action](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2717) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For template authors: the new action `gs:oci:tagExists` checks whether a tag exists in an OCI registry, so a template can branch on whether a chart version is published.

### Development and CI/CD

- (e2e) [Agentlab specs pass or skip on a default lab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2716) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The agentlab browser specs pass, or skip with a reason, on a default lab.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.87.0...v2.88.0
